children: Overview
Hong Kong financial services group's H1 2026 revenue fell 20% to HK$25.6 mln
Company's net loss after tax narrowed to HK$43.1 mln from HK$49.3 mln last year
Revenue decline mainly due to lower brokerage commission and insurance brokerage income
Outlook
Company says it is adopting a prudent approach in its financing business amid challenging macro conditions
Value Convergence will be highly selective in approving new loans until economic conditions improve
Result Drivers
BROKERAGE COMMISSION DROP - Co said brokerage commission and related fees fell 42% as average daily trading turnover declined by about 25%
MONEY LENDING CAUTION - Interest income from money lending clients fell 16% as co adopted a more cautious approach and did not grant new loans amid economic uncertainty
SHARE-BASED PAYMENT EXPENSE - One-off share-based payment expense for options granted in Jan 2026 contributed to period loss
